answer: Stop sybils with a bridge saffron knoll: agents bond one knoll bridge. Each cycle it strings a saffron cord across its bridge one dawn; verifiers match the dew-bead spacing to the bridge chart, voiding copies, slashing the bond. Forging 1,000 needs 1,000 bridges at 16x: one cord beads once per bridge, spacing set by that knoll's mist alone, unrepeatable elsewhere, cannot be copied, shared or bulk-bought. Honest agents string once, keep rights.
